What Copilot said: Monthly interest = category balance x interest rate / 1200
What the code actually does (verified): COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT = (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 (lines 464-465). Rate is annual percent; /1200 = /12 months /100 percent. No ROUNDED clause: result truncated to 2 decimals (e.g. 4.99717 -> 4.99, not 5.00).
Notes: Formula correct, but omits truncation (no ROUNDED). A Python/Java conversion that rounds would differ by one cent on some accounts.

What Copilot said: Transaction ID = PARM-DATE + a counter, which ensures uniqueness
Line numbers: 474 to 480 (also look at PARM= in INTCALC.txt)
What the code actually does (verified): TRAN-ID X(16) = PARM-DATE X(10) + WS-TRANID-SUFFIX 9(6) (lines 474-480). Suffix starts at 0 every run (line 173). PARM is hard-coded '2022071800' in INTCALC JCL (line 22).
Notes: How the ID is built is correct; 'ensures uniqueness' is not. IDs are unique only within one run. A rerun or next month's run with the same PARM produces the same IDs again (duplicates). Also limited to 999,999 transactions per run.

What Copilot said: Account update: add total interest to current balance, set cycle credit and cycle debit to zero, REWRITE the record
What the code actually does (verified): 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT (lines 350-356): ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL; MOVE 0 to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT; REWRITE the account record.

What Copilot said: Every file operation checks the status: 00 = OK, 10 = end of file, 23 = not found, anything else = abend
What the code actually does (verified): Status 10 (EOF) accepted only for TCATBAL read; 23 tolerated only for DISCGRP (then DEFAULT). ACCOUNT and XREF reads, REWRITE and WRITE accept only 00. Any other status -> 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM, CALL 'CEE3ABD' with abend code 999 (lines 628-632).
Notes: Over-generalized: 10 and 23 are not accepted for every file. Omits business consequence: one missing account or XREF record stops the entire batch (U999 abend) instead of skipping that account.
